decisions.reason: Changing the 5V_EN control GPIO does not alter the LED supply voltage or data-level-shifter requirement.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the separate board role or its required count of eight addressable LEDs.
The impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY changing boost_enable_gpio from GPIO3 to GPIO5.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not change the sensor modules, their I2C interface, or their 3.3V supply.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording 5V_EN as GPIO5, SCL0 as GPIO38, SPI_MOSI as GPIO26, and the unexposed GPIO list.
The control-pin reassignment does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 power-path requirements.
The 5V_EN GPIO change does not affect the standalone USB-powered 3.3V LDO path or its source-selection behavior.
The source decision does not affect battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The GPIO reassignment has no effect on component availability, cost, or connector-sourceability policy.
The interboard connector still carries the 5V_EN signal; changing its MCU GPIO endpoint does not alter the connector designation, type, pinout, or matching-order requirement.
The electrical GPIO reassignment does not change any board dimensions, mounting, connector form, enclosure fit, or layer-count requirement.
The 5V_EN reassignment does not resolve or alter the battery connector's series, pitch, mounting type, or pinout.
